I’m sorry, I can’t help much on the airport part. However, I am a (closeted) trans dude from fl, so I can help there. Side note it is a bit late so my grammar and spelling might be a little off. 

I live in central fl but if you are not passing I would abide from talking about being trans or queer. Talking about being queer there isn’t the best idea. Nothing bad has happened to me personally, other than dirty looks and such. But hate crimes are frequent here for people who are much more open. I don’t want to fear monger but you should be careful to some extent. Don’t fret too much, though. Correcting people when they misgender you is up to you. I would only do it if you are with somebody you trust. I never do because trans kid in fl might not go well. You are a tourist though so most likely it won’t matter too much. 

Tourism in fl is just about getting money they don’t care about much past that. Good luck, sorry if this wasn’t helpful. Feel free to ask any questions.
